y-m-35-01.title: |x−2|=2x−7: deebii barattoota lamaanii adda
y-m-35-01.topic: Wal-madaallii gatii cufaa qabu: dhimma hundatti gatiiwwan filatamoo haala dhimma sanaa eeganii jiraachuu isaanii mirkaneessuu
y-m-35-01.goal: Wal-madaallii gatii cufaa qabuuf, gatiiwwan filatamoo dhimmoota qooduudhaan argaman keessaa kamtu furmaata akka ta'e sababa wajjin murteessi, wal-madaallii gatiin filatamaan itti kuffifamu mataa kee hojjedhu.
y-m-35-01.material:
Barattoonni lama wal-madaallii |x − 2| = 2x − 7 (x lakkoofsa dhugaa dha) furan. Akkamitti dubbifama: '|x − 2| = 2x − 7' 'gatii cufaa x gad-baasi 2 dha, 2x gad-baasi 7 wajjin walqixa'. Lamaanuu 'yeroo x ≥ 2' fi 'yeroo x < 2' jedhanii qoodudhaan jalqaban.
· Yeroo x ≥ 2: x − 2 = 2x − 7 irraa, x = 5 bahe.
· Yeroo x < 2: −(x − 2) = 2x − 7 irraa, x = 3 bahe.
Barataan 가 'x = 3 ykn x = 5' jedhe, barataan 나 immoo 'x = 5' jedhe.

Dhugaadhaan, yoo x = 3 galchite, gama lamaanuu 0 dha, kanaaf x = 3 furmaata dha.
